title: Riverdale Stables
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Please call or visit the office to book your next lesson one to seven days in advance of the date you’d like to ride. We accept cash, credit cards or checks, but do require you provide us with a valid credit card number when you book your first lesson. This card will only be charged in the event of a late cancellation or failure to show up for a lesson.
